mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a cosmetic update and a full renovation for a rental?

acceptedAnswer.text: A cosmetic update typically involves superficial changes that enhance appearance without altering the property's structure or layout. This includes fresh paint, new flooring, updated light fixtures, and minor repairs. These are generally quicker and less expensive. A full renovation, conversely, involves more extensive work like reconfiguring layouts, gutting kitchens or bathrooms, replacing major systems (plumbing, electrical), or making structural changes. Full renovations are more time-consuming and costly but can dramatically transform a property's functionality and value. The choice depends on the property's current condition and your investment goals.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cosmetic updates involve superficial changes like paint and flooring, while full renovations include structural changes, layout reconfigurations, or major system replacements, offering a greater transformation.
